title: Enonic XP 8 platform
text: Enonic XP is an open-source platform for building content-driven apps and headless CMS solutions. XP 8 is the current major line. Content Studio 6 (the editorial UI) requires XP 8.0 or newer. Keep XP 7 material separate and explicitly labelled — it is a different major version.

title: Content Studio — the editorial UI
text: Content Studio is Enonic's editor. Content lives in a tree under a Site; each item has a content TYPE (schema). Editors Save (Lagre), Mark as ready (Marker som klar) and Publish (Publiser). The Draft branch is what editors see; the Master branch is what the public frontend reads.

title: Headless delivery (Guillotine GraphQL + Next.js)
text: In a headless setup the frontend fetches content from XP's Guillotine GraphQL API and renders it elsewhere. The Red Cross public site is a Next.js app that reads published content and uses ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) to serve and revalidate pages.

title: Red Cross content types (deployed)
text: The deployed rodekors app exposes exactly 7 content types (verified via /admin/rest-v2/cs/schema/content/all): branch-district (Distrikt), branch-local (Lokalforening), frontpage (Forside), list-page (Listeside), news-article, page (= 'Side', also labelled 'Fagartikkel'), story-article. 'Fakta' (fact) and 'topic' were added later (schema/content/all → 9 rodekors types, 2026-11). The multi-page FORM type is now deployed too, as 'no.item.forms:form' (Item Consulting Forms app, Content Studio 6.1.0).

title: Public URL patterns
text: Public URLs strip the '/rodekors' site root. Districts: /distrikter/D000…D018 (e.g. D000 Mollekleiva, D001 Østfold, D003 Oslo). Local branches: /lokalforeninger/L000… (L000 Nøklebye, L001 Rakkestad). A Fakta has its own page under its parent (e.g. /fakta/fakta-om-sudan). Content Studio path /rodekors/distrikter/D0NN maps to public /distrikter/D0NN.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (URL recipe, 2026-11)

title: Publish flow (Publiseringsveiviser)
text: To publish: Lagre → Marker som klar → Publiser nå. For a parent + its children use 'Publiser trestruktur' (publish tree). In the wizard, 'Under arbeid (N)' items need 'Marker som klar' (Publiser nå stays DISABLED until then); 'Ugyldige elementer' must be excluded with 'Utelat'; unpublished dependencies appear under AVHENGIGHETER with their checkbox UNCHECKED = excluded by default.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (publish wizard, 2026-11)

title: New-slug propagation to the public frontend
text: Observed 2026-11: NEWLY created page slugs return a soft 'Ikke funnet' (HTTP 200 with a Next.js notFound body) on next.lunix.cloud and do not appear until a frontend rebuild. CHANGES to an ALREADY-LIVE page DO propagate on publish (ISR revalidates existing paths). Workaround for visitor tests: modify an existing live page instead of creating a new slug. This is a frontend/infra behaviour of the test environment, not a CMS bug — confirm the revalidation story with the dev.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (propagation blocker, 2026-11-03/04)

title: District vs local-branch contact data
text: Lokalforeninger carry REAL per-branch CRM data (branch-specific Besøksadresse + email on the ostfoldrk.no / rodekors.org domains) and show a 'Kontakt oss' header. The 20 districts currently share generic national data (post@redcross.no / (+47) 22 05 40 00) and a 'Kontakt' header. So generic district contact info is a CRM-load characteristic of the test data, not a render bug.

title: Toppbanner (image vs buttons) on branch pages
text: On a Lokalforening/Distrikt, the toppbanner 'Bilde' (image) + alt text ARE content fields and render on publish ('Foto:' credit = the image media's Kunstner field). The toppbanner CTA BUTTONS ('Bli frivillig' as primary + a second button) are NOT in the deployed frontend (no knapp/CTA field on the content type; no button rendered on any branch page) — a feature not yet deployed (test 29376 FAIL). The link-as-buttons config also exists as a page-template part that is template-LOCKED (needs 'Tilpass side').

title: Fakta + Listeside (list page)
text: A 'Listeside' (list-page, 'Utlisting av innhold under') lists the content under it; config = Innholdstyper filter (empty = all), Vis antall resultater, Vis sortering. A 'Fakta' (fact) is used in block content via a 'Gjenbruk' block that selects the fakta; a Fakta's fields are 'Illustrasjon' (image OR video block) + 'Tekst' (the visible body). Observed: the 2-column faktaboks layout is NOT in the deployed frontend yet (renders stacked; test 30075 FAIL).

title: Required fields & invalid content block publish
text: Save (Lagre) is allowed even when a content is invalid, but publishing is stopped: an invalid ('Ugyldig') content shows NO publish button in browse, and in the editor 'Flere handlinger' the Marker som klar / Publiser / Publiser trestruktur items are disabled. Example: an Ikoner block entry requires both 'Ikon' and 'Beskrivelse'; a Kort card requires an 'Intern lenke'; a branch image with no own alt text makes 'Beskrivelse av bildet (alt text)' required ('Beskriv bildet for brukere med synshemminger').

title: Feature deployment status (authored vs merged)
text: Several test cases were authored before their feature was merged. Status as of Sprint 8 (2026-11): NOW DEPLOYED and testable — the multi-page form/skjema (no.item.forms:form), the ankerlenke-meny / SNARVEIER anchor menu, the Kart (map) Innholdsblokk, and the «Vis mer» long-fakta truncation. STILL NOT in the deployed frontend — the toppbanner CTA buttons ('Bli frivillig', 29376 FAIL) and the 2-column / wide faktaboks layout (renders stacked; 30075/30080). New Sprint 8 areas (Relatert innhold cards, sticky snarveier, Unitas external-data sync) are authored but not yet executed. Confirm a feature's status with the dev before deep testing.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (deployment status, 2026-11, Sprint 7-8)

title: Kart (map) block — MapLibre (Sprint 8)
text: The 'Kart' block (an Innholdsblokk on a Side, and a 'Fakta' illustration option) renders with MapLibre GL and is deployed on xp8dev. Config: Blokktittel, Introtekst, Senter (center as 'lat,long'), Zoom (0-22, decimals allowed) and a Markører list — each marker is a 'Koordinatpunkt' with an address/coordinate and an optional Tekst. Verified behaviour (Sprint 8): a marker WITH text shows as a red dot whose click opens a popup (text above the marker, an «×»/Lukk closes it, marker stays); a marker WITHOUT text is inert (normal cursor, no hover colour, no popup). Markers at the SAME coordinate merge into one marker whose popup groups all texts stacked with a thin separator. Zooming out clusters markers into a red circle with a count that counts EACH marker (incl. same-address ones); hovering a cluster darkens it + shows a hand cursor; clicking a cluster zooms in until the markers separate. The map uses cooperative gestures: plain wheel scrolls the PAGE and shows 'Bruk Ctrl + rulling for å zoome i kartet', Ctrl/⌘+scroll zooms. When the browser cannot use WebGL, a grey rounded box 'Kartet kan ikke vises.' replaces the map.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (Kart/map 30419-30447, Sprint 8, 2026-11)

title: Create content under the site root / a parent
text: In browse, clear any active search (Nullstill, else the tree stays filtered), select the 'Røde kors' root row, press alt+n → 'Lag innhold på: /' → pick the type → set 'Visningsnavn' → Lagre (use the real toolbar Lagre; the back-arrow discards unsaved new content with no confirm). To create a CHILD, select the parent row first, then alt+n (dialog shows 'Lag innhold på: /parent/path/').
sources: Red Cross QA test log (content creation recipe, 2026-11)

title: Rich-text (Ingress / Tekst) does not save via typing
text:
The CKEditor rich-text fields (Ingress, a Tekst block body) do NOT persist when typed via automation — they mark unsaved but save EMPTY. The reliable way is to set the data programmatically and fire change: CKEDITOR.instances['htmlarea-intro-0'].setData('

…

'); then fire 'change'; then Lagre. A 'Tekst' block title becomes an H2 whose id is the slugified title.

title: Verify rendering on the public frontend
text: Verify behaviour by reading the DOM of next.lunix.cloud (the Master branch; no login) rather than the editor preview (which renders the Draft branch). Confirm a publish truly completed (CS toast 'har blitt publisert' + toolbar flips to 'Avpubliser') before trusting the public page; '?v=' cache-busting alone will not surface a publish that did not go through. Responsive checks: emulate the viewport width and reload.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (verification recipe, 2026-11)

title: Run visitor tests on existing live pages (propagation workaround)
text: Because new slugs do not propagate, run visitor (Sluttbruker) tests by MODIFYING an existing live page and reverting after. Reusable harness: a live page with a 'Lenker' block (e.g. Test Fil 29334) — swap its linked file/tags and republish, verify on its existing public URL, then restore the original. For branch tests, temporarily add an image / social links to an existing lokalforening (e.g. Rakkestad L001) and revert.
sources: Red Cross QA test log (existing-page unlock, 2026-11-04)

title: How to draft a manual test from a title only
text: When only a case TITLE is known (no official steps), produce a clearly-labelled PROPOSED procedure: persona + preconditions + test data + numbered action/expected-result pairs + negative cases + evidence to capture + cleanup. Give it a local draft ID, never an invented Azure DevOps ID, and state that the official steps and exact expected behaviour are still missing until the real export is imported.
